errors.text: The proposed strain-rate window of 10^-4 to 10^3 s^-1 does not overlap the target molecular-dynamics range of 10^8 to 10^10 s^-1, so its rate-insensitivity boundary does not reconstruct the relevant result.

It predicts an FCC-to-HCP transformation at low temperature or high rate, whereas the target mechanism is Shockley-partial slip producing local stacking-fault-associated HCP-like coordination without a bulk phase transformation.

The central phase-transformation claim is extrapolated primarily from a quinary CoNiCrFeMn nanowire at 77 K, not bulk single-crystal equiatomic FeNiCrMn; size, composition, and geometry materially alter deformation mechanisms.
The stated condition excluding elements such as Cr is inconsistent with the target FeNiCrMn composition, which necessarily contains Cr.
No cited evidence directly supports the claimed 300–500 K strain-rate-insensitive plateau or the proposed transition above 10^3 s^-1.
